AI pipeline: cheaper drafts, steadier scores, grounded comics

2026-10-22 · PoSeeReview · options A1–A10. "After" was captured against Azurite with a real generation, a real remaster and a real triage; "before" is commit 973930e on production data.

  • Comic page: a Why 54? panel with the three ratings the score is computed from, which reviews (position + stars) each strip came from with a link to the listing, a Remastered badge once the premium painter redraws a popular comic, and a ✂ sticker button.
  • Discovery: cached forecasts grey out places already known to be too ordinary, so nobody waits ten seconds for a sad trombone.
  • Account menu: an opt-in AI voice chip (Kokoro, on-device).
  • Moderation: an AI triage button and its stored advice beside the row.

Comic page, desktop 1366×900

The strip on the right is the Gemini remaster of a gpt-image-1-mini draft, made by ComicRemasterService five minutes after start: same scenes, same captions, same score, blob overwritten in place. The before is the older prompt-v3 comic from production storage.

Comic page, mobile 390 wide

Discovery, list view

Forecasts are read from PoSeeReviewAnalyses, never computed for the probe (search results carry no reviews, and a Place Details call per pin would cost more than the comic). A repeat attempt on a too-normal place now reuses the cached verdict: 0 scorer calls.
